sections.title: One sentence
sections.body: The stable identity of one source document across its versions.

sections.title: In plain language
sections.body: Your notebook remains the same notebook even after you edit a page.

sections.title: Concrete example
sections.body: Renaming a Drive file does not necessarily mean it is a different document.

sections.title: In this Knowledge OS
sections.body: Source-scoped external identity identifies the Document; CURRENT_VERSION points to its current snapshot.

sections.title: Why it exists
sections.body: Stable identity connects updates and deletion observations to one history.

sections.title: Technical detail
sections.body: Document identity is not the same as content hash. Metadata and permissions participate in versioning.
